criteria.evidence: Bidirectional package/file, router/file, and consumer-dependency/file censuses; missing, duplicate, wrong-role, inferred-authority, undeclared-file, and mixed-owner fixtures.
criteria.outcome: Each `pdf-evidence-transcription-v1` package has one stored PDF, source manifest, manually maintained transcription XML, generated Markdown view, and only registered assets or convenience derivatives. The PDF governs fidelity; XML alone owns asserted transcription, provenance, stable IDs, and typed metadata. Package, router, and consumer ownership closes bidirectionally.

criteria.evidence: Exact document-root, XSD/profile, item/node/field/type/value-model/hierarchy/order/dependency census; parse-serialize byte equality; readable-spelling, whitespace, digest-scope, identity, provenance, missing/wrong-kind/cycle, and resource-limit fixtures.
criteria.id: SSM-PDF-AC-02 — XML item-surface and readable-storage closure
criteria.outcome: Each package exposes one addressable typed document root and content items with stable non-positional IDs, closed ordered hierarchy, exact typed content and metadata, provenance, uncertainty, and applicable dependencies/assets. XSD/profile agreement covers every reachable node, scalar, and value model; typed-item digests exclude the XML envelope and formatting. Every XML equals the readable storage law.

criteria.evidence: PDF name/signature, checksum, size, manifest, copy-status, extraction-method, source-path, asset, derivative, OCR-authority, and false-assurance fixtures.
criteria.id: SSM-PDF-AC-03 — Evidence binding and assurance closure
criteria.outcome: Each manifest binds the exact stored PDF path/signature, raw digest, size, evidentiary role, copy status, extraction method, assets, and non-authoritative derivatives. Exact-byte checks and OCR prove neither authenticity nor transcription fidelity, legal correctness, approval, or filing readiness.

criteria.evidence: Cross-process rendering and independent serializer/item/field/provenance/dependency/asset/digest/anchor/region census; missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, self-report, and stored-evidence fixtures.
criteria.id: SSM-PDF-AC-04 — Generated Markdown and coverage closure
criteria.outcome: Fresh XML-to-Markdown rendering is byte-identical to the review view. Coverage independently recomputes readable serialization, every item and field, provenance, dependency/asset, manifest raw binding, typed-item digest, origin, and anchor; renderer self-report and stored evidence have no authority.

criteria.evidence: Exact edge/handoff and validation-read censuses; retained-control, nested-mutation, byte-equality, representation-isolation, direct-read/reopen, conflicting-handoff, detached-token, undeclared-read, fallback, no-authority-write, atomic-rollback/readback, and external-mutation fixtures.
criteria.id: SSM-PDF-AC-05 — Snapshot-bound handoff, commands, and writes
criteria.outcome: Before model construction or writes, each declared edge constructs one handoff from a root-bound retained-byte snapshot after package, parser-control, surface, binding, generated-view, and coverage validation. Controls and handed state are transitively immutable; XML receives the frozen surface/assets and Markdown only review bytes. Reopen, detached tokens, inference, fallback, promotion, and pre-write-state reuse fail.

criteria.evidence: Exact contract/registry/schema/profile/parser/serializer/renderer/surface/consumer/package/test census; storage-law, typed-field, whole-profile, partial-update, control-bypass, handoff-bypass, alternate-path, compatibility, and stored-record fixtures.
criteria.id: SSM-PDF-AC-06 — Field evolution, audit, and implementation closure
criteria.outcome: A transcription-field, storage-law, or typed-digest change coherently updates its XML owner, schema/profile, parser/serializer, renderer, coverage, bindings, consumers, and tests. Exact live closure has no parser-control bypass, second surface builder, mutable handoff, alternate path, untyped extension, consumer semantic field, unused digest mechanism, stored evidence, compatibility path, or residue.
